identity.title: [v0.92][WP-18C.04b][114.b] Persist conversation watermarks, idempotency, replay, and receipts

values.summary: Implemented the #277 Runtime conversation continuity layer for durable watermarks, conversation-scoped monotonic attempt-local idempotency, replay decisions, ambiguous-dispatch outcomes, and receipts without absorbing #278, #114 parent, #115, or #270/#276 authority.
